title: AnalysisPlan 2.0: the analysis that would reduce one named uncertainty
description: Written before anything executes. The required field is uncertainty_ref: an analysis that answers no stated question cannot be constructed, which is the structural difference between this and a bioinformatics dashboard. The plan also names the decision it could affect and the process parameters that might change, so a result can be read against what it was asked for rather than against what it happened to find.

created_by.description: bioinformatics_agent, policy, or a person's name

question.description: The biological question, in the terms a person would ask it

uncertainty_ref.description: MANDATORY. Either a hypothesis the analysis already raised (kind hypothesis, ref = a hypothesis_id in the analysis report's diagnosis) or an explicitly recorded gap in the evidence (kind evidence_gap). Planning is refused without one.

source_artifact.description: Path to the analysis report or record the uncertainty came from

why_requested.description: Why this is being asked now, rather than revising or stopping

analysis_type.description: Phase 2 set. Single-cell pseudobulk needs the optional singlecell environment; chromatin reads processed peak files. A tool that cannot run is not registered, so an unavailable analysis is refused at planning rather than at execution.

readouts.description: Which measured columns to compare; empty means every numeric column

value_column.description: The measured column to compare, when the tool cannot tell from its name.

feature_column.description: The column naming each gene or feature, when the tool cannot tell from its name.

steps.description: What the tool will do, in order, for a reader who will not run it

name.description: A name in the tool registry; an unknown tool is refused

external.description: true when execution goes through the external-tool adapter (R, Scanpy, MACS). Phase 1 ships the contract and a mock.

required_metadata.description: Manifest fields this analysis cannot run without. Checked against the manifest before execution; a missing one refuses the plan and names it.

decision_relevance.description: Which process decision this could inform. Not a promise that it will.

parameters_that_may_change.description: Protocol parameters the result might implicate, named in advance so a result cannot be read as supporting whatever it happens to favour.
